'''Péter Varjú''' is a Hungarian mathematician who works in [[harmonic analysis]] and [[ergodic theory]]. He is a professor at the [[University of Cambridge]].

==Education and career==
Varjú was born in [[Szeged]]. He did his undergraduate studies at the University of Szeged<ref name=fulbright/> and his doctoral studies at [[Princeton University]], where he defended his thesis ''Random walks and spectral gaps in linear groups'' in 2011 under the supervision of [[Jean Bourgain]].<ref>{{mathgenealogy|239949}}</ref>

He works at the [[University of Cambridge]], as a professor in the Department of Pure Mathematics and Mathematical Statistics.<ref>{{citation|url=https://www.dpmms.cam.ac.uk/person/pv270|title=Professor Peter Varju |work=Department of Pure Mathematics and Mathematical Statistics|publisher=University of Cambridge|access-date=2025-07-24}}</ref>

==Research==
Varjú studied the construction of [[expander graphs]] with [[number theory|number-theoretic]] methods involving [[arithmetic group]]s{{ran|A}} and questions about the uniform distribution of [[random walk]]s in arithmetic groups with Bourgain{{ran|B}} and in Euclidean isometries with [[Elon Lindenstrauss]].{{ran|C}}{{ran|D}}

==Recognition==
Varjú received the 2016 [[EMS Prize]]<ref>{{citation|url=https://www.ams.org/journals/notices/201809/rnoti-p1118.pdf|title=Prizes Awarded at the ECM|department=Mathematics People|journal=[[Notices of the American Mathematical Society]]|pages=1064–1065|volume=63|issue=9|date=October 2016}}</ref> and the 2018 [[Whitehead Prize]].<ref>{{citation|url=https://www.ams.org/journals/notices/201809/rnoti-p1118.pdf|title=Prizes of the London Mathematical Society|department=Mathematics People|journal=[[Notices of the American Mathematical Society]]|page=1122|volume=65|issue=9|date=October 2018}}</ref> As a graduate student at Princeton, he was also a [[Fulbright Fellow]].<ref name=fulbright>{{citation|url=https://2009-2017.state.gov/documents/organization/143494.pdf|contribution=International Fulbright S&T Fellows: 2007 – 2010|page=17|title=International Fulbright Science & Technology Award: Capstone Seminar for 2007-2010 International Fulbright Science & Technology Fellows|publisher=Fulbright Program|date=June 2010|access-date=2025-07-24}}</ref>
